text: article_reviewer rewrites the draft's 'I find / I would watch' observer cues into forms its own first-person detector rejects ('What I keep coming back to is…'), HELDing a healthy draft; an identical re-run accepted — retry the run once before hand-editing.
illustration_overlay renders a hook up to 88 chars past the image edge mid-word (the wrapper does not wrap the hook line); keep hooks to ~72 chars and vision-check the overlay strip before the push.

The frontier rewrite re-imports figures from the brief's prose (Durability paragraph), not just the verified rows — the 2026-11-23 SQEP run's rewrite added 'thresholds last moved in 2018, 85% to 87%' from the evergreen brief's Durability line, a figure no verified row carried and whose only source was an unreachable host. It also silently dropped the hand-written inline internal link and the evergreen: true flag. After adopting a held attempt, diff it against the draft specifically for (1) figures not in the verified brief's rows, (2) the inline internal link, (3) the frontmatter flags.
